If the work has any of the following identifiers, then one of these specific templates may be used:
* [[digital object identifier|DOI]]: {{tl|cite doi}}
* [[JSTOR]]: {{tl|cite jstor}}
* [[PubMed]]: {{tl|cite pmid}}

==Usage==
{{csdoc|usage}}

{{csdoc|usage full}}
:<code><nowiki>{{cite conference |url= |title= |first= |last= |author= |authorlink= |date= |year= |conference= |conferenceurl= |editor= |others= |volume= |edition= |booktitle= |publisher= |archiveurl= |archivedate= |location= |pages= |format= |id= |isbn= |bibcode= |oclc= |doi= |accessdate= |quote= |ref= |separator= |postscript= |language= |page= |at= |trans_title= }}</nowiki></code>
{{end}}

==Examples==
*<code><nowiki>{{cite conference |author=AUTHOR |authorlink=Example |date=January 2006 |title=TITLE |booktitle=BOOKTITLE |url=http://www.wikipedia.com |accessdate=April 7, 2006 |isbn=1-111-22222-3}}</nowiki></code>
